content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves D5 vs C5 by the sign's open sense rather than by weighing the pressing side's chain against the link by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: one reading requires the judge to assess the combined chain's support by footing; the other permits treating an individual sign's open sense as enough to leave the link underdetermined.","why":"The judge states underdetermined because the sign's sense is left open, which uses verse-level openness instead of the required chain-against-chain footing."}
